purpose: Teach: 文藝春秋/自営業/発刊/主将/関心事/講堂/ブレーク/学識

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、文藝春秋に当社の記事が載ったぞ
lines.en: When we founded the company, our story appeared in Bungei Shunju.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia with quiet pride. Slow, measured pace. Eyes slightly distant, seeing the memory. Voice carries the weight of decades—not heavy, but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは自営業の頃から人脈を築かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father built his network even back when he was self-employed.
lines.style: Steady, respectful acknowledgment. Slight lean forward in posture. Not defensive—affirming. The cadence of a son honoring what his father laid down.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内誌の発刊号を自ら手がけられたぞ
lines.en: He edited the company magazine's first issue himself.
lines.style: Voice softens with wonder. Pause before 'himself'—letting the weight of that single-handed effort land. Slow delivery, as if handling something fragile and precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員野球部の主将的存在でした
lines.en: Yes. Father was the heart of the company baseball team—led the spirit of it.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Gentle smile in the voice. A moment of genuine warmth breaking through formality. Speaking of a time when he knew his father in a different light.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様の関心事を最優先された
lines.en: He always put the customer's interests first.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet conviction. Not lecturing—observing. Slight trailing emphasis on 'first.' The tone of someone who watched this principle shape everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員総会を講堂で大々的に行われた
lines.en: Yes. Father treasured his relationships with scholars and experts in the field.
lines.style: Firm, clear respect. Slight upward inflection on 'treasured'—emphasizing deliberation, not accident. Grounded tone. Speaking of inherited values.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界のブレークスルーを起こされた
lines.en: He fundamentally shifted how the industry worked.
lines.style: Voice rises slightly with the weight of the accomplishment. Pause before the final phrase. Slow, deliberate—like placing something carefully on a shelf to be remembered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは学識経験者との人脈を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father cultivated those connections with thought leaders as something sacred.
lines.style: Measured, closing tone. Quiet gravity. A slight slowdown at the end, as if sealing the thought. Warm but formal—the son carrying his father's legacy forward with care.
